name: zanker-component-design
description: Build reusable accessible UI components in the existing frontend stack.

workflow.instruction: Locate current equivalents; choose extend, compose or create, with rationale.
Define semantic props, states, keyboard behavior, loading/error and disabled logic.
Render in Zanker sandbox with realistic scenarios.
Run visual/accessibility checks and produce patch, examples and acceptance criteria.

fallback: If component cannot be isolated, use framework-native preview and disclose parity gap.
